chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Muhammad ibn Mihran, from 'Abd Allah ibn Sinan, from Abi 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:

I said to him: A man is in the masjid, in salat, and wants to spit. So he said: To his left. And if he is not in salat, then he should not spit facing the qiblah, and he may spit to his right and his left.

key_terms.الصَّلَاةِ: salat; the ritual prayer during which specific conduct is required
key_terms.الْمَسْجِدِ: the mosque; the sacred space in which etiquette is observed

ai.seo_question: Where should a person spit if he is in the masjid and in salat?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding proper conduct when spitting in the masjid, especially during salat. It distinguishes between the state of salat and outside of salat, while emphasizing respect for the qiblah and proper mosque etiquette.
